english: I have too many things that need my attention, and I can't decide which I should prioritize!
french: Je dois m'occuper de trop de choses en même temps et je n'arrive pas à me décider sur l'ordre des priorités !
russian: Так много вещей требует моего внимания, что я даже не знаю, чему уделить время!
bulgarian: I have too many things that need my attention, and I can't decide which I should prioritize!

english: Which is the most time-sensitive?
french: Quelle est la plus urgente ?
russian: А что самое срочное?
bulgarian: Which is the most time-sensitive?

english: Which will affect more people?
french: Laquelle touche le plus de monde ?
russian: А что больше всего затрагивает окружающих?
bulgarian: Which will affect more people?

english: Take a break... prioritize yourself!
french: Fais une pause... La priorité, c'est toi !
russian: Сделай перерыв... Удвли время себе!
bulgarian: Take a break... prioritize yourself!

english: Thanks, [Ari]. I'll take care of that first.
french: Merci, [Ari]. Je vais commencer par m'occuper de ça.
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]. Первым делом возьмусь за него.
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari]. I'll take care of that first.

english: A break?
french: Une pause ?
russian: Перерыв?
bulgarian: A break?

english: B-but I have so much to do!
french: Mais j'ai tellement de choses à faire !
russian: Но... У меня же столько незаконченных дел!
bulgarian: B-but I have so much to do!

english: Sorry, [Ari]...
french: Je regrette, [Ari]...
russian: Прости, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Sorry, [Ari]...

english: Don't worry, I'll figure it out.
french: Ne t'inquiète pas, je vais me débrouiller.
russian: Не волнуйся, я что-нибудь придумаю.
bulgarian: Don't worry, I'll figure it out.

english: I'll take a break after, okay?
french: Je ferai une pause plus tard, d'accord ?
russian: А потом сделаю перерыв, ладно?
bulgarian: I'll take a break after, okay?

english: Hmmm. Well, probably my response to the Adventurer's Guild.
french: Hmmm. Eh bien, sans doute la réponse que je dois apporter à la guilde des aventuriers.
russian: Хмм. Наверное, написать ответ в гильдию приключенцев.
bulgarian: Hmmm. Well, probably my response to the Adventurer's Guild.

english: They asked if everything is going well, and I'd like to assure them that it is.
french: Ils m'ont demandé si tout se passait bien et j'aimerais les rassurer sur ce point.
russian: Они спрашивали, как у нас идут дела, и я собираюсь заверить, что всё в порядке.
bulgarian: They asked if everything is going well, and I'd like to assure them that it is.

english: Honestly, I should have replied sooner, but it slid to the bottom of my to-do list last week.
french: J'aurais dû leur répondre plus tôt, mais ça a fini par glisser à la dernière place de ma liste de choses à faire, la semaine dernière.
russian: Честно говоря, мне надо было ответить раньше. Но на прошлой неделе в моём списке дел оно ушло в самый низ.
bulgarian: Honestly, I should have replied sooner, but it slid to the bottom of my to-do list last week.

english: I'm sure I'll feel much better if I take care of that first.
french: Je suis certaine que je me sentirai mieux si je commence par régler ça.
russian: Уверена, мне станет легче, когда я с этим разделаюсь.
bulgarian: I'm sure I'll feel much better if I take care of that first.

english: Thanks, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari].

english: Hmmm. Well, probably my petition to the Merchant's Guild to lower import taxes on food items.
french: Hmmm. Sans doute ma demande officielle à la guilde des marchands, afin qu'ils baissent les taxes à l'importation sur les denrées alimentaires.
russian: Хммм. Наверное, прошение о снижении налогов на импорт продовольствия в гильдию торговцев.
bulgarian: Hmmm. Well, probably my petition to the Merchant's Guild to lower import taxes on food items.

english: It would ease some of our supply issues if I'm able to get them to agree...
french: Cela résoudrait certains de nos problèmes d'approvisionnement si j'arrivais à les convaincre...
russian: Если у меня получится их уговорить, это немного облегчит наши проблемы с поставками...
bulgarian: It would ease some of our supply issues if I'm able to get them to agree...

english: And that would be a good thing for everyone in town!
french: Et ce serait donc une bonne chose pour tout le monde, en ville !
russian: А это — благо для всего города!
bulgarian: And that would be a good thing for everyone in town!

english: Today's just one of those days...
french: Il y a des jours comme ça...
russian: Снова такой суматошный день...
bulgarian: Today's just one of those days...

english: Sometimes when the kids are being really wild, Nora will ask me to issue an order to the Dragonguard... they always snap to attention. It's SO cute!
french: Quand les enfants sont trop difficiles, Nora me demande parfois de donner un ordre à la Garde des dragons... Ils deviennent aussitôt attentifs. C'est mignon !
russian: Порой дети совсем теряют голову, и тогда Нора просит меня отдать Драконьей страже официальный приказ... Они всегда как по струнке встают, ТАК мило!
bulgarian: Sometimes when the kids are being really wild, Nora will ask me to issue an order to the Dragonguard... they always snap to attention. It's SO cute!

english: Great Aunt Elsie... I hope I can grab onto life like she does. Her life is SO exciting.
french: Grand-tante Elsie... J'espère embrasser l'existence comme elle le fait. Sa vie est tellement palpitante.
russian: Надеюсь, я всегда буду такой же живой, как тётушка Элси. Её жизнь ТАКАЯ яркая.
bulgarian: Great Aunt Elsie... I hope I can grab onto life like she does. Her life is SO exciting.

english: Valen says I'm not allowed to pull all-nighters anymore.
french: Valen m'a interdit de continuer à faire des nuits blanches.
russian: Вален запрещает мне теперь работать по ночам.
bulgarian: Valen says I'm not allowed to pull all-nighters anymore.

english: You're so dependable, [Ari]. I'm thrilled you answered the call to settle in Mistria!
french: Tu es tellement fiable, [Ari]. Je suis très heureuse que tu aies répondu à l'appel pour t'installer à Mistria !
russian:
Приятно, что на тебя можно положиться, [Ari]. Я так рада, что ты

приняли

принялапринялприняло моё предложение поселиться в Мистрии.
bulgarian: You're so dependable, [Ari]. I'm thrilled you answered the call to settle in Mistria!

english: It's no understatement to say that you've transformed Mistria, [Ari]. From the bottom of my heart, I am grateful!
french: Ce n'est pas un euphémisme de dire que tu as transformé Mistria, [Ari]. Je t'en suis reconnaissante, du fond du cœur !
russian:
[Ari], сказать, что ты

преобразили

преобразилапреобразилпреобразило Мистрию, — не преувеличение. Я благодарна тебе от всего сердца!
bulgarian: It's no understatement to say that you've transformed Mistria, [Ari]. From the bottom of my heart, I am grateful!

english: Balor's great at sourcing all kinds of things, but his bookkeeping and documentation are a little...
french: Balor est imbattable sur la variété de son approvisionnement, mais sa tenue de comptes et ses documents administratifs sont un peu...
russian: Балор отлично справляется с поставками любых товаров, но вот бухгалтерию он ведёт так себе...
bulgarian: Balor's great at sourcing all kinds of things, but his bookkeeping and documentation are a little...

english: Wait, I guess that IS a little suspicious...
french: Minute, peut-être que ÇA, c'est un peu louche...
russian: Если подумать, ВСЁ-ТАКИ это подозрительно...
bulgarian: Wait, I guess that IS a little suspicious...

english: People weren't sure about Balor at first, but he's been very helpful since he came to Mistria. He always has just what we need whenever we're in a bind with the reconstruction...
french: Les habitants doutaient un peu de Balor, au début, mais il nous a aidés dès son arrivée à Mistria. Il a toujours pile ce qu'il faut quand nous sommes coincés pour la reconstruction...
russian: Люди не сразу приняли Балора, но он очень помог нам, как появился в Мистрии. Если нам чего-то не хватает для реставрации, он всегда достаёт всё необходимое...
bulgarian: People weren't sure about Balor at first, but he's been very helpful since he came to Mistria. He always has just what we need whenever we're in a bind with the reconstruction...

english: Hello!
french: Bonjour !
russian: Привет!
bulgarian: Hello!

english: And that's why I put it on my schedule!
french: C'est pour ça que je le note dans mon planning !
russian: Именно поэтому я её и записала в своё расписание!
bulgarian: And that's why I put it on my schedule!

english: Whew... a nice, relaxing bath was just what I needed.
french: Pfiou... Un bon bain relaxant... J'en avais bien besoin.
russian: Фух... Расслабляющая ванна... Как раз то, что мне было нужно.
bulgarian: Whew... a nice, relaxing bath was just what I needed.

english: The bathhouse is lovely. No wonder Aunt Elsie spends so much time there.
french: Les bains sont un endroit ravissant. Pas étonnant que tante Elsie y passe autant de temps.
russian: Купальня — такое чудесное место. Не удивительно, что тётушка Элси проводит в ней столько времени.
bulgarian: The bathhouse is lovely. No wonder Aunt Elsie spends so much time there.

english: I had to jot down a really good idea! Civil infrastructure can't wait!
french: Il fallait absolument que je note rapidement une idée ! Les infrastructures civiles n'attendent pas !
russian: Мне надо было срочно записать идею! Гражданская инфраструктура не ждёт!
bulgarian: I had to jot down a really good idea! Civil infrastructure can't wait!

english: I told Juniper I dropped my pencil in the bath, and she gave me the most withering look.
french: Quand j'ai dit à Juniper que j'avais laissé tomber mon crayon dans le bain, elle m'a jeté un regard noir.
russian: Я сообщила Джунипер, что потеряла карандаш в ванной, и получила от неё убийственный взгляд.
bulgarian: I told Juniper I dropped my pencil in the bath, and she gave me the most withering look.

english: My hair feels amazing after every visit!
french: À chacun de mes passages, je sens que mes cheveux sont fortifiés !
russian: Каждый раз, когда к ней захожу, волосы потом просто великолепные!
bulgarian: My hair feels amazing after every visit!

english: I swear Juniper's got some magic formula for the baths...
french: Je jurerais que Juniper utilise des formules magiques pour les bains...
russian: Я клянусь, у Джунипер в ванной какая-то магия...
bulgarian: I swear Juniper's got some magic formula for the baths...

english: I smell lavender and roses from the bath! I can't wait to jump in.
french: Je sens d'ici l'odeur de lavande et de rose monter du bain ! J'ai hâte de m'y plonger.
russian: Из ванны пахнет лавандой и розами! Так и хочется запрыгнуть.
bulgarian: I smell lavender and roses from the bath! I can't wait to jump in.

english: I'm glad you're here to enjoy it too, [Ari]!
french: Je suis contente que tu en profites aussi, [Ari] !
russian: Я рада, что ты тоже здесь, [Ari], и можешь этим насладиться!
bulgarian: I'm glad you're here to enjoy it too, [Ari]!

english: The Beach is so peaceful...
french: La plage est si paisible...
russian: Пляж такой умиротворяющий...
bulgarian: The Beach is so peaceful...

english: Even though it pinched me!
french: Même s'il m'a pincée !
russian: Хоть он меня и цапнул!
bulgarian: Even though it pinched me!

english: I saw a crab, [Ari]! It was so cute!
french: J'ai vu un crabe, [Ari] ! Il était très mignon !
russian: [Ari], я видела краба! Такой милашка!
bulgarian: I saw a crab, [Ari]! It was so cute!

english: I suppose it's not a bad rule.
french: Ce n'est pas une mauvaise règle, je crois.
russian: Думаю, это неплохое правило.
bulgarian: I suppose it's not a bad rule.

english: I tried to talk to Balor about some of our supply issues, but he said the beach is for relaxing.
french: J'ai tenté de parler à Balor de certains problèmes d'approvisionnement, mais il m'a dit que la plage, c'était fait pour se détendre.
russian: Я пыталась поговорить с Балором о проблемах с поставками, но он сказал, что на пляже нужно отдыхать.
bulgarian: I tried to talk to Balor about some of our supply issues, but he said the beach is for relaxing.

english: We're definitely related.
french: Nous ne sommes pas frère et sœur pour rien, décidément.
russian: Мы и правда родственники.
bulgarian: We're definitely related.

english: I thought my brother would make fun of me for turning a beach trip into work, but it turns out he was looking for fossils the whole time!
french: J'imaginais que mon frère se moquerait de moi parce que la sortie à la plage s'était transformée en séance de travail, mais il a passé son temps à chercher des fossiles !
russian: Я думала, брат засмеёт меня, что я взяла работу с собой на пляж. А он и сам всё это время окаменелости тут искал!
bulgarian: I thought my brother would make fun of me for turning a beach trip into work, but it turns out he was looking for fossils the whole time!

english: Oh [Ari], why am I like this...
french: Oh [Ari], je suis vraiment incorrigible...
russian: Эх, [Ari], даже не знаю, что со мной...
bulgarian: Oh [Ari], why am I like this...

english: I'm not working! I'm just... checking the shoreline for signs of erosion.
french: Je ne travaille pas ! Je... vérifie s'il y a des signes d'érosion sur le trait de côte.
russian: Да не работаю я! Я просто... проверяю, не разрушается ли береговая линия.
bulgarian: I'm not working! I'm just... checking the shoreline for signs of erosion.

english: Isn't it beautiful out here, [Ari]?
french: C'est splendide ici, tu ne trouves pas, [Ari] ?
russian: Разве здесь не прекрасно, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Isn't it beautiful out here, [Ari]?

english: It's tomorrow.
french: Mais c'est demain.
russian: Но он завтра.
bulgarian: It's tomorrow.

english: A Lady is not supposed to speak of her birthday, so I won't.
french: Une dame n'est pas censée parler de son anniversaire, alors je ne le ferai pas.
russian: Леди не пристало напоминать о своём дне рождения, так что я не буду.
bulgarian: A Lady is not supposed to speak of her birthday, so I won't.

english: Celine's always bringing me new flowers for the manor... she puts so much thought into the arrangements.
french: Céline m'apporte souvent de nouvelles fleurs pour le manoir... Ses compositions sont toujours pleines d'inspiration.
russian: Селин всё время приносит для нашего особняка свежие цветы... Она так заботится, чтобы всё хорошо украсить.
bulgarian: Celine's always bringing me new flowers for the manor... she puts so much thought into the arrangements.

english: The King has only ever given out a handful of them, to exceptional individuals who have worked hard for Aldaria!
french: Le roi n'en a décerné que très peu, et seulement à des personnes exceptionnelles qui ont travaillé très dur pour Aldaria !
russian: Король присуждал эту награду всего несколько раз. Она полагается выдающимся личностям за труд на благо Альдарии.
bulgarian: The King has only ever given out a handful of them, to exceptional individuals who have worked hard for Aldaria!

english: Congratulations on receiving the Champion's Shield, [Ari]!
french: Félicitations, [Ari], tu as reçu le bouclier de champion !
russian: Поздравляю с Щитом чемпиона, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Congratulations on receiving the Champion's Shield, [Ari]!

english: I appreciate so much that you check in on Great Aunt Elsie. She's more than I can keep up with!
french: J'apprécie sincèrement que tu rendes visite à grand-tante Elsie de temps en temps. Avec elle, j'ai du mal à suivre le rythme !
russian: Я очень благодарна, что ты навещаешь тётушку Элси. Я сама за ней угнаться не могу!
bulgarian: I appreciate so much that you check in on Great Aunt Elsie. She's more than I can keep up with!

english: Be sure to check the board every day... I'm always posting new requests! There's so much to be done, I'm so lucky I can rely on you.
french: Pense à vérifier le panneau tous les jours... J'y affiche souvent de nouvelles requêtes ! Il y a tant à faire, j'ai de la chance de pouvoir compter sur toi.
russian: Не забывай проверять доску прошений каждый день... Я всегда помещаю туда новые объявления! Дел очень много, и я рада, что на тебя можно положиться.
bulgarian: Be sure to check the board every day... I'm always posting new requests! There's so much to be done, I'm so lucky I can rely on you.

english: Darcy's pastries and coffee are amazing! I hope you had a chance to try them yourself.
french: Les pâtisseries et le café de Darcy sont incroyables ! J'espère que tu as eu l'occasion d'y goûter.
russian: Выпечка и кофе у Дарси просто великолепны! Надесь, тебе уже удалось попробовать.
bulgarian: Darcy's pastries and coffee are amazing! I hope you had a chance to try them yourself.

english: I'm a little worn out after the market... this calls for a hearty meal.
french: Je suis un peu fatiguée après le marché... Il me faut un repas roboratif.
russian: Я немного утомилась после базара... Время хорошенько покушать.
bulgarian: I'm a little worn out after the market... this calls for a hearty meal.

english: I'm looking forward to the next time.
french: J'attends avec impatience la prochaine fois.
russian: С нетерпением жду следующего раза.
bulgarian: I'm looking forward to the next time.

english: That evening of Dragons & Drama was more gripping than I expected. Enough for me to forget about work!
french: Cette soirée de Dangers & Dragons était plus prenante que ce à quoi je m'attendais. Assez pour me faire oublier le travail !
russian: Вечер «Перепалок & Драконов» был полон неожиданных событий. Я даже от работы отвлеклась!
bulgarian: That evening of Dragons & Drama was more gripping than I expected. Enough for me to forget about work!

english: I'm doing my rounds! Let me know if you've got any thoughts about the town, okay?
french: Je fais ma tournée ! Dis-moi si tu as des idées pour la ville, d'accord ?
russian: Я осматриваю город. Расскажи мне, если у тебя появятся по поводу него какие-нибудь мысли, хорошо?
bulgarian: I'm doing my rounds! Let me know if you've got any thoughts about the town, okay?

english: I'm so excited for Friday night, I just couldn't wait!
french: J'attends toujours le vendredi soir avec impatience.
russian: Наконец-то пятница! Как же я ждала этого вечера!
bulgarian: I'm so excited for Friday night, I just couldn't wait!

english: It's so wonderful how everyone pitched in! Especially you, [Ari]!
french: Tout le monde a mis la main à la pâte, c'est fantastique ! Toi en particulier, [Ari] !
russian: Так здорово, что каждый вносит свой вклад. И твой вклад — особенный, [Ari]!
bulgarian: It's so wonderful how everyone pitched in! Especially you, [Ari]!

english: The path of recovery from the earthquake has been paved by the hard work of the community.
french: C'est le travail acharné de la communauté qui a pavé la voie vers la reconstruction, après le tremblement de terre.
russian: Дорожка к восстановлению после землетрясения проложена усилиями всего нашего сообщества.
bulgarian: The path of recovery from the earthquake has been paved by the hard work of the community.

english: The earthquake really devastated Mistria, and it's thanks to people like you that we're getting things back to normal. Better, even!
french: Le séisme a vraiment dévasté Mistria et c'est grâce à des personnes comme toi que les choses reviennent à la normale. En mieux, même !
russian: Землетрясение чуть не разрушило Мистрию, но благодаря людям вроде тебя мы смогли вернуть всё на круги своя. И даже больше!
bulgarian: The earthquake really devastated Mistria, and it's thanks to people like you that we're getting things back to normal. Better, even!

english: I don't really understand what Eiland is doing with his excavations and the Museum, but I'm happy that he's passionate about it...
french: Je ne comprends pas vraiment ce que fait Eiland avec ses fouilles et le musée, mais je suis contente que ça le passionne...
russian: Я не очень понимаю, чего это Эйланд, вообще, носится со своими раскопками и музеем, но я рада, что он нашёл своё призвание...
bulgarian: I don't really understand what Eiland is doing with his excavations and the Museum, but I'm happy that he's passionate about it...

english: I can't take the day off, but I can get started on my beach improvement plan!
french: Je ne peux pas prendre ma journée, mais je peux commencer à travailler sur mon projet d'amélioration de la plage !
russian: Выходной я себе позволить не могу, а вот думать, как улучшить пляж, я начну уже сегодня!
bulgarian: I can't take the day off, but I can get started on my beach improvement plan!

english: Elsie says I should take the day off and go to the Beach.
french: Elsie me dit que je devrais prendre ma journée et aller à la plage.
russian: Элси говорит, мне нужен выходной на пляже.
bulgarian: Elsie says I should take the day off and go to the Beach.

english: Great Aunt Elsie was out carousing last night, but I've never seen her with a hangover.
french: Grand-tante Elsie est sortie faire la fête, hier soir, mais je ne l'ai jamais vue avoir... mal aux cheveux.
russian: Тётушка Элси вчера устроила себе вечеринку. Я ни разу не видела её в похмелье.
bulgarian: Great Aunt Elsie was out carousing last night, but I've never seen her with a hangover.

english: He kept going back in, until he got every miner out. He takes his responsibilities very seriously.
french: Il est retourné plusieurs fois à l'intérieur, jusqu'à ce que tous les mineurs soient sortis. Il prend ses responsabilités très au sérieux.
russian: Он не успокоился, пока не вытащил из завалов всех шахтёров. Он очень серьезно относится к своим обязаностям.
bulgarian: He kept going back in, until he got every miner out. He takes his responsibilities very seriously.

english: Errol used to be the foreman of the Mines, before the earthquake caused a tunnel collapse.
french: Errol était contremaître dans les mines, avant que le tremblement de terre n'entraîne l'effondrement d'un tunnel.
russian: Эррол раньше руководил шахтой. До того, как землетрясение разрушило туннели.
bulgarian: Errol used to be the foreman of the Mines, before the earthquake caused a tunnel collapse.

english: The manor garden is so pretty in autumn! Celine's really outdone herself.
french: Le jardin du manoir est tellement joli en automne ! Céline s'est vraiment surpassée.
russian: Сад особняка так прекрасен в осеннюю пору! Селин идеально постаралась.
bulgarian: The manor garden is so pretty in autumn! Celine's really outdone herself.

english: It's a fine fall day for some quests, don't you think?
french: Quelle belle journée d'automne pour réaliser quelques quêtes, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Прекрасный осенний денёк для парочки заданий, не думаешь?
bulgarian: It's a fine fall day for some quests, don't you think?

english: You know that fountain in the town square? Eiland and I played in it when we were children.
french: Tu vois la fontaine, sur la place du marché ? Enfants, nous nous amusions dedans, Eiland et moi.
russian: Знаешь фонтан на городской площади? Мы с Эйландом в детстве там часто играли.
bulgarian: You know that fountain in the town square? Eiland and I played in it when we were children.

english: The turning of the seasons is so exciting. Time for a fresh start for the request board!
french: Le changement de saison est tellement enthousiasmant. Le moment est venu de renouveler le panneau des requêtes !
russian: Обожаю смену времён года. И доска прошений обновляется под стать природе!
bulgarian: The turning of the seasons is so exciting. Time for a fresh start for the request board!

english: You know, when we were kids he'd sometimes eat it straight from a bag, haha!
french: Tu sais, quand nous étions enfants, il lui arrivait de le piquer directement dans le paquet, ha ha !
russian: Представляешь, когда мы были маленькие, он иногда ел сахар прямо из мешка, ха-ха!
bulgarian: You know, when we were kids he'd sometimes eat it straight from a bag, haha!

english: Wait... you don't think...
french: Attends... Tu crois que...?
russian: Стоп... неужели...
bulgarian: Wait... you don't think...

english: Let's see, Eiland asked for... a bag of sugar?
french: Voyons, Eiland m'avait demandé... un paquet de sucre ?
russian: Посмотрим, Эйланд попросил... мешок сахара?
bulgarian: Let's see, Eiland asked for... a bag of sugar?

english: The weather is so pretty in the fall, and it's my last chance to work out of doors before winter puts me back in the office.
french: Le temps est si agréable en automne... C'est ma dernière chance de travailler dehors avant que l'hiver me renvoie dans mon bureau.
russian: Осенью такая чудесная погода. К тому же это последний шанс поработать на свежем воздухе: зимние морозы загонят меня в офис.
bulgarian: The weather is so pretty in the fall, and it's my last chance to work out of doors before winter puts me back in the office.

english: I'm writing some grant proposals to pass along to the Capital, and I thought I might as well do it outside.
french: Je suis en train de rédiger quelques demandes de prêt à l'attention de la capitale, et je me suis dit que je pourrais aussi bien le faire à l'extérieur.
russian: Я сейчас работаю над заявками на гранты в столицу. Подумала, что это можно делать и на улице.
bulgarian: I'm writing some grant proposals to pass along to the Capital, and I thought I might as well do it outside.

english: Let's keep working hard for Mistria's sake!
french: Continuons à travailler dur pour le bien de Mistria !
russian: Давай выложимся по полной ради Мистрии!
bulgarian: Let's keep working hard for Mistria's sake!

english: You're always so busy, [Ari]. It keeps me motivated.
french: Tu es toujours <he>si actif</he><she>si active</she><they>en train de t'activer</they>, [Ari]. Cela me motive.
russian:
Ты всегда чем-то

заняты

занятазанятзанято, [Ari]. Это и меня мотивирует.
bulgarian: You're always so busy, [Ari]. It keeps me motivated.

english: I'm so glad it's to your liking!
french: Je suis tellement contente que ça te plaise !
russian: Я так рада, что тебе здесь нравится!
bulgarian: I'm so glad it's to your liking!

english: It seems like you're settling into the swing of life here in Mistria.
french: On dirait que tu t'adaptes bien au rythme de Mistria.
russian: Кажется, ты уже привыкаешь к жизни в Мистрии.
bulgarian: It seems like you're settling into the swing of life here in Mistria.

english: I've got big hopes for you, [Ari]!
french: Je fonde de grands espoirs sur toi, [Ari] !
russian: У меня на тебя большие надежды, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I've got big hopes for you, [Ari]!

english: I strongly recommend all of it!
french: Je te conseille tout ce qu'il y a à la carte !
russian: Очень рекомендую попробовать всё!
bulgarian: I strongly recommend all of it!

english: Morning, [Ari]! Have you tried anything off of the Inn's breakfast menu?
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! As-tu déjà testé le petit-déjeuner de l'auberge ?
russian:
[Ari], доброе утро! Уже

попробовали

попробовалапопробовалпопробовало что-нибудь из меню завтраков в трактире?
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! Have you tried anything off of the Inn's breakfast menu?

english: March and Ryis are right... there's something nice about a drink after a long day of work.
french: March et Ryis ont raison... C'est assez agréable de se désaltérer après une longue journée de travail.
russian: Март и Риз были правы... Есть что-то в том, чтобы выпить чего-нибудь прохладительного после рабочего дня.
bulgarian: March and Ryis are right... there's something nice about a drink after a long day of work.

english: Morning paperwork over some of Reina's =Wild Berry Scones=... ooh, I just know it's going to be a great day!
french: De la paperasse matinale tout en savourant quelques =scones aux baies sauvages= de Reina... Oh, la journée sera bonne, je le sais déjà !
russian: Утро начинается с ведения документов и =лепёшек с дикими ягодами= от Рейны... Ох, чувствую, день пройдёт прекрасно!
bulgarian: Morning paperwork over some of Reina's =Wild Berry Scones=... ooh, I just know it's going to be a great day!

english: But don't worry! I live to organize!
french: Mais sois tranquille ! L'organisation, c'est toute ma vie !
russian: К счастью, я обожаю всё организовывать!
bulgarian: But don't worry! I live to organize!

english: Turning everyone's requests into quests for the board takes a lot of organizing.
french: Transformer les demandes de chacun en quêtes destinées au panneau demande beaucoup d'organisation.
russian: Нужно много организованности, чтобы правильно оформить прошения для доски.
bulgarian: Turning everyone's requests into quests for the board takes a lot of organizing.

english: Don't you just love the smell of ink and =Paper=?
french: J'adore l'odeur du =papier= et de l'encre, pas toi ?
russian: Разве запах чернил и =бумаги= не прекрасен?
bulgarian: Don't you just love the smell of ink and =Paper=?

english: You look exhausted. I appreciate all you're doing for the town, but please mind your energy levels. Here's a snack!
french: Tu sembles au bord de l'épuisement. J'apprécie tout ce que tu fais pour la ville, mais attention à ton niveau d'énergie. Voici un encas !
russian: Ты выглядишь устало. Я ценю твой вклад в развитие города, но не пренебрегай запасами своей энергии. Вот, держи перекус!
bulgarian: You look exhausted. I appreciate all you're doing for the town, but please mind your energy levels. Here's a snack!

english: Lumber is plentiful in Mistria, but we must start a program of replanting for future generations.
french: Il y a beaucoup d'arbres à Mistria, mais nous devons lancer un programme de reforestation à l'attention des générations futures.
russian: В Мистрии нет недостатка древесины, но если мы хотим, чтобы так было и впредь, нам нужно запланировать посев новых деревьев.
bulgarian: Lumber is plentiful in Mistria, but we must start a program of replanting for future generations.

english: You should feel free to pick the roses on the manor grounds too, [Ari]. They're for everyone!
french: Sens-toi libre de cueillir toi aussi les roses qui poussent sur le terrain du manoir, [Ari]. Elles sont pour tout le monde !
russian: Если захочешь, не стесняйся нарвать роз и себе, [Ari]. Сад — для всех!
bulgarian: You should feel free to pick the roses on the manor grounds too, [Ari]. They're for everyone!

english: Juniper said she used some of the roses from the manor garden to prepare today's bath oils! Isn't that exciting?
french: Juniper m'a dit avoir utilisé certaines roses du jardin du manoir pour préparer les huiles de bain d'aujourd'hui ! C'est passionnant, non ?
russian: Джунипер говорит, что использовала для сегодняшнего банного масла розы из сада особняка! Как здорово!
bulgarian: Juniper said she used some of the roses from the manor garden to prepare today's bath oils! Isn't that exciting?

english: Mom and dad would be so happy to see the garden now! It's so pretty.
french: Maman et papa seraient tellement heureux de voir le jardin en ce moment ! Il est si joli.
russian: Мама и папа были бы счастливы, если бы увидели каким стал сад! Так красиво.
bulgarian: Mom and dad would be so happy to see the garden now! It's so pretty.

english: I wonder what kinds of flowers these are. I should ask Celine.
french: Je me demande quelles sont ces fleurs. Je devrais poser la question à Céline.
russian: Интересно, что это за цветы. Надо спросить Селин.
bulgarian: I wonder what kinds of flowers these are. I should ask Celine.

english: I wonder how she's doing! I should write her soon.
french: Je me demande comment elle va ! Je devrais lui écrire.
russian: Интересно, как у неё дела. Нужно бы ей написать.
bulgarian: I wonder how she's doing! I should write her soon.

english: My mother and I used to go on walks in the garden every day, before she moved to the Capital.
french: Ma mère et moi avions l'habitude de faire des promenades dans le jardin tous les jours avant qu'elle déménage à la capitale.
russian: Мы с матушкой раньше каждый день ходили на прогулки по саду. Пока она не переехала в столицу.
bulgarian: My mother and I used to go on walks in the garden every day, before she moved to the Capital.

english: Elsie says it was a simple but beautiful wedding.
french: D'après Elsie, c'était un mariage très simple, mais magnifique.
russian: Элси говорит, что свадьба была скромная, но всё равно красивая.
bulgarian: Elsie says it was a simple but beautiful wedding.

english: I wish I could've seen it!
french: J'aurais adoré voir ça !
russian: Жаль, что я не видела!
bulgarian: I wish I could've seen it!

english: I'm not sure if I've ever mentioned it, but Mother and Father were married out by the gazebo!
french: Je ne sais plus si je te l'avais déjà dit, mais ma mère et mon père se sont mariés sous le kiosque !
russian: Возможно, я раньше не упоминала, но мама с папой поженились возле беседки!
bulgarian: I'm not sure if I've ever mentioned it, but Mother and Father were married out by the gazebo!

english: I don't think March likes making something as simple as nails, but everyone's got to pitch in for the recovery effort.
french: Je ne crois pas que March apprécie de fabriquer des objets aussi simples que des clous, mais tout le monde doit faire des efforts pour la reconstruction.
russian: Не думаю, что Марту интересно делать простые гвозди, но для реконструкции необходима помощь каждого.
bulgarian: I don't think March likes making something as simple as nails, but everyone's got to pitch in for the recovery effort.

english: Oh, hello [Ari]! I'm inspecting the town square in advance of the Market tomorrow.
french: Oh, bonjour, [Ari] ! Je vérifie que tout est en ordre sur la place avant l'installation du marché, demain.
russian: Ох, здравствуй, [Ari]! Я осматриваю площадь перед завтрашним Субботним базаром.
bulgarian: Oh, hello [Ari]! I'm inspecting the town square in advance of the Market tomorrow.

english: Unfortunately, Eiland liked to play "rampaging dragon".
french: Malheureusement, Eiland, lui, adorait jouer au « dragon destructeur ».
russian: К сожалению, Эйланд любил играть в «разбушевавшегося дракона».
bulgarian: Unfortunately, Eiland liked to play "rampaging dragon".

english: When I was a child I used to build scale models of Mistria out of snow!
french: Quand j'étais enfant, je bâtissais des modèles réduits de Mistria dans la neige !
russian: Когда я была маленькой, я лепила из снега миниатюрные модели Мистрии!
bulgarian: When I was a child I used to build scale models of Mistria out of snow!

english: [Ari]! I hope Mistria is treating you well.
french: [Ari] ! J'espère que tout se passe bien pour toi à Mistria.
russian: [Ari]! Надеюсь, Мистрия хорошо тебя принимает.
bulgarian: [Ari]! I hope Mistria is treating you well.

english: I wonder how Mother and Father are faring in the Capital. I hope the metropolitan life suits them...
french: Je me demande comment ma mère et mon père se portent. J'espère que la vie à la capitale leur convient...
russian: Интересно, как у матушки и отца дела в столице. Надеюсь, городская жизнь им по душе...
bulgarian: I wonder how Mother and Father are faring in the Capital. I hope the metropolitan life suits them...

english: Ahhh, a bath first thing really is the best way to start the day.
french: Ah, un bain au saut du lit est vraiment le meilleur moyen de commencer la journée.
russian: Ах... начинать день с ванны — лучшая идея.
bulgarian: Ahhh, a bath first thing really is the best way to start the day.

english: I love music night! Clap with me, [Ari]!
french: J'adore les soirées musicales ! Tape des mains avec moi, [Ari] !
russian: Обожаю музыку по вечерам! Похлопай со мной, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I love music night! Clap with me, [Ari]!

english: Oh, [Ari]! It always makes my day when you come to say hello.
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Chaque fois que tu passes me saluer, cela illumine ma journée.
russian: О, [Ari]! Мой день всегда становится лучше, когда ты заходишь поздороваться.
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! It always makes my day when you come to say hello.

english: I knew I had to step up when the earthquake hit Mistria, but I couldn't have done it without Nora... she really helped me get things moving in the early days.
french: Je savais que je devais m'impliquer quand le séisme a frappé Mistria, mais je n'y serais pas arrivée sans Nora... Elle m'a aidé à tout mettre en route les premiers jours.
russian: Я знала, что должна помочь Мистрии после землетрясения, но я бы не справилась без Норы... Она очень помогла. Поставила всё на поток в самые первые дни.
bulgarian: I knew I had to step up when the earthquake hit Mistria, but I couldn't have done it without Nora... she really helped me get things moving in the early days.

english: She's such an inspiration!
french: Elle est vraiment un modèle pour moi !
russian: Как же это вдохновляет!
bulgarian: She's such an inspiration!

english: Nora's books are always so clean! Everything is accounted for, every time.
french: Les livres de comptes de Nora sont tellement impeccables ! Tout y est enregistré, à chaque fois.
russian: Бухгалтерия Норы такая прозрачная! Всё посчитано, каждая мелочь учтена.
bulgarian: Nora's books are always so clean! Everything is accounted for, every time.

english: Ah, that's not a royal decree or anything though! It would just be nice.
french: Bien sûr, ce n'est pas une ordonnance royale ! Ce serait juste gentil.
russian: Ах, это не королевский приказ, если что! Просто было бы здорово.
bulgarian: Ah, that's not a royal decree or anything though! It would just be nice.

english: Sigh. My administrative duties frequently keep me holed up in my office. Do come by and say hello... It gets a little lonely in there.
french: Ahhh. À cause de mes obligations administratives, je reste souvent enfermée dans mon bureau. Passe me dire bonjour... Je me sens un peu seule ici.
russian: Эх. Административные обязанности держат меня в плену моего кабинета. Заходи иногда поздороваться... А то тут бывает одиноко.
bulgarian: Sigh. My administrative duties frequently keep me holed up in my office. Do come by and say hello... It gets a little lonely in there.

english: Oh, hi [Ari]! I'm consolidating my latest notes about the town's restoration. I thought it was important to record some things for posterity, you know?
french: Oh, salut [Ari] ! Je rassemble mes dernières notes concernant la remise en état de la ville. Je me disais qu'il était important d'enregistrer certains éléments pour la postérité.
russian: О, привет, [Ari]! Я собираю последние записи по восстановлению города. Подумала, будет полезно сохранить их на будущее.
bulgarian: Oh, hi [Ari]! I'm consolidating my latest notes about the town's restoration. I thought it was important to record some things for posterity, you know?

english: It was just the one time!
french: C'est arrivé une seule fois !
russian: Хотя это было всего один раз!
bulgarian: It was just the one time!

english: Whew, I had better start winding down in here. I'm getting tired, and Elsie and Eiland forbade me from napping in the office.
french: Pfiou, je ferais bien de lever un peu le pied. Je fatigue et Elsie et Eiland m'ont interdit de faire la sieste ici, dans le bureau.
russian: Фух, кажется, пора заканчивать на сегодня. Я начинаю уставать, а Элси и Эйланд запретили мне спать в кабинете.
bulgarian: Whew, I had better start winding down in here. I'm getting tired, and Elsie and Eiland forbade me from napping in the office.

english: But since I need the paper, it feels like a waste of resources to write the request...
french: Mais comme j'en manque, j'ai l'impression de gâcher des ressources en écrivant cette demande...
russian: Но для этого нужна бумага, а я не хочу тратить ценный ресурс на листок с заказом...
bulgarian: But since I need the paper, it feels like a waste of resources to write the request...

english: I need to put in a request for more paper...
french: Je dois demander à ce qu'on me fournisse plus de papier...
russian: Пора бы написать заказ на бумагу...
bulgarian: I need to put in a request for more paper...

english: The warm mug keeps my hands cozy too!
french: Et la tasse tiède me réchauffe aussi les mains !
russian: И кружка приятно греет руки!
bulgarian: The warm mug keeps my hands cozy too!

english: A bit of hot =Coffee= is especially nice in the winter.
french: Un petit =café= chaud en plein hiver, il n'y a rien de mieux.
russian: Зимой особенно хорошо выпить горяченького =кофе=.
bulgarian: A bit of hot =Coffee= is especially nice in the winter.

english: That's why I asked Eiland to take over her old office...
french: C'est pour ça que j'ai demandé à Eiland de s'installer dans la pièce où elle travaillait...
russian: Поэтому я попросила Эйланда взять её офис...
bulgarian: That's why I asked Eiland to take over her old office...

english: Can't risk falling into that old habit when work needs doing!
french: Je ne peux pas risquer de reprendre cette vieille habitude quand j'ai du travail !
russian: А то вдруг старая привычка нагрянет, когда я в работе!
bulgarian: Can't risk falling into that old habit when work needs doing!

english: During the winter when I was really little, I'd curl up and nap underneath my mother's desk.
french: En hiver, quand j'étais toute petite, je me pelotonnais sous le bureau de ma mère pour faire la sieste.
russian: Когда я была совсем маленькая, я любила зимой сворачиваться и засыпать под маминым рабочим столом.
bulgarian: During the winter when I was really little, I'd curl up and nap underneath my mother's desk.

english: Oh, [Ari]! I was just making some preliminary festival notes to share with Nora.
french: Oh, [Ari] ! J'écrivais juste quelques remarques préliminaires en vue de la fête pour les partager avec Nora.
russian: Ой, [Ari]! Я тут решила набросать черновые планы к фестивалю, потом покажу Норе.
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! I was just making some preliminary festival notes to share with Nora.

english: They're a lot of work, but I love planning them!
french: Cela représente une belle charge de travail, mais j'adore m'en occuper !
russian: Это трудная работа, но мне так нравится её планировать!
bulgarian: They're a lot of work, but I love planning them!

english: The cost of three booths inclusive of the time to run them is...
french: Le coût de trois stands, si l'on prend en compte le temps nécessaire à la gestion de chacun, est de...
russian: Итого затраты на три лавки, включая постройку и рабочее время...
bulgarian: The cost of three booths inclusive of the time to run them is...

english: Eiland could probably tell you more.
french: Eiland pourrait probablement t'en dire plus.
russian: Но об этом лучше говорить с Эйландом.
bulgarian: Eiland could probably tell you more.

english: That statue on your farm might be older than the rest of Mistria. It's the oldest thing here, as far as our written records are concerned.
french: Il se pourrait que la statue de ta ferme soit plus ancienne que le reste de Mistria. C'est le plus vieil objet ici, si l'on en croit nos archives écrites.
russian: Статуя на твоей ферме, кажется, старше самой Мистрии. Она старше всего, что у нас числится в записях.
bulgarian: That statue on your farm might be older than the rest of Mistria. It's the oldest thing here, as far as our written records are concerned.

english: Look forward to it!
french: Tiens-toi prêt !
russian: Надеюсь, ты ждёшь этого!
bulgarian: Look forward to it!

english: Morning, [Ari]! I'm itemizing some things so I can get the request board updated.
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Je détaille un certain nombre de choses afin de mettre à jour le panneau des requêtes.
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]! Я просто сортирую некоторые вещи, чтобы обновить доску прошений.
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! I'm itemizing some things so I can get the request board updated.

english: Poor Nora...
french: Pauvre Nora...
russian: Бедная Нора...
bulgarian: Poor Nora...

english: Celine told me that Dell once hid a lizard in the register of the General Store.
french: Céline m'a raconté qu'une fois, Dell avait caché un lézard dans la caisse enregistreuse du magasin général.
russian: Селин рассказала мне, что Делл как-то раз спрятала ящерицу в кассе универмага.
bulgarian: Celine told me that Dell once hid a lizard in the register of the General Store.

english: I'm on a tear today! Sometimes leaving my office really helps open my frame of mind.
french: Je suis en forme, aujourd'hui ! Parfois, quitter mon bureau m'aide vraiment à me mettre dans de bonnes dispositions.
russian: Я сегодня в ударе! Иногда выйти из кабинета помогает взглянуть на всё по-новому.
bulgarian: I'm on a tear today! Sometimes leaving my office really helps open my frame of mind.

english: Don't suppose I could interest you in a teensy quest or two today? Lots of good stuff!
french: Est-ce que je pourrais oser te demander de mener une petite quête ou deux, aujourd'hui ? Que des quêtes de qualité !
russian: Как насчёт парочки заданий сегодня? У меня тут много интересного!
bulgarian: Don't suppose I could interest you in a teensy quest or two today? Lots of good stuff!

english: Morning, [Ari]! I was posting some new requests on the board... have at it!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! J'étais en train d'afficher de nouvelles requêtes sur le panneau... Jettes-y un œil !
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]! Я как раз вешаю новые объявления на доску прошений... Смотри на здоровье!
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! I was posting some new requests on the board... have at it!

english: It makes my efforts feel worthwhile!
french: Cela donne du sens à tous mes efforts !
russian: Чувствую, что делаю полезное дело!
bulgarian: It makes my efforts feel worthwhile!

english: [Ari]! It always makes me so happy to see you checking the quest board.
french: [Ari] ! Je suis toujours très heureuse de te voir consulter le panneau des quêtes.
russian: [Ari]! Меня всегда так радует видеть, что ты проверяешь доску прошений.
bulgarian: [Ari]! It always makes me so happy to see you checking the quest board.

english: It makes me so happy!
french: J'en suis très heureuse !
russian: Это так меня радует!
bulgarian: It makes me so happy!

english: I really appreciate you taking on so many requests from the board, [Ari]. Efficiency is way up since you moved to Mistria.
french: J'apprécie sincèrement que tu acceptes de te charger de tant de requêtes du panneau, [Ari]. L'efficacité est au top depuis ton installation à Mistria.
russian: Я очень ценю, что ты разбираешь так много объявлений с доски прошений, [Ari]. Эффективность сильно повысилась с твоим приездом в Мистрию.
bulgarian: I really appreciate you taking on so many requests from the board, [Ari]. Efficiency is way up since you moved to Mistria.

english: But it seems to be working just fine to me!
french: Moi, j'ai l'impression qu'il est en parfait état !
russian: Но мне кажется, всё и так в порядке!
bulgarian: But it seems to be working just fine to me!

english: Landen asked if the Request Board needs any repairs...
french: Landen a demandé si le panneau des requêtes avait besoin d'être réparé...
russian: Ланден спросил, не нужен ли доске прошений ремонт...
bulgarian: Landen asked if the Request Board needs any repairs...

english: I was still working out my request board system last year, but now it feels like old hat!
french: L'an dernier, je réfléchissais encore à mon système pour le panneau des requêtes. J'ai l'impression que c'était il y a une éternité !
russian: Только в прошлом году я разрабатывала систему прошений, а сейчас это уже кажется чем-то обыденным!
bulgarian: I was still working out my request board system last year, but now it feels like old hat!

english: It's always so exciting to see them checked off when I go to post new ones!
french: Je suis tellement enthousiaste de voir qu'elles sont cochées quand je vais en poster de nouvelles !
russian: Так приятно видеть на них галочки, когда я прихожу вешать новые!
bulgarian: It's always so exciting to see them checked off when I go to post new ones!

english: Thanks so much for taking on so many requests, [Ari]!
french: Merci beaucoup de te charger de tant de demandes, [Ari] !
russian: Спасибо тебе большое, что берёшь столько заказов, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thanks so much for taking on so many requests, [Ari]!

english: They're worth an awful lot of $Renown$, aren't they?
french: Elles permettent d'acquérir énormément de $renommée$, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Они приносят просто уйму $репутации$!
bulgarian: They're worth an awful lot of $Renown$, aren't they?

english: How are things going with fulfilling the $Crown Requests$, [Ari]?
french: Comment ça se passe pour la réalisation des $requêtes royales$, [Ari] ?
russian: Как идут дела с $заказами Короны$, [Ari]?
bulgarian: How are things going with fulfilling the $Crown Requests$, [Ari]?

english: Then they swordfight with the icicles! Honestly, it looks kind of fun.
french: Ensuite, ils utilisent les stalactites pour faire des combats à l'épée ! Honnêtement, ça a l'air assez amusant.
russian: А потом они устраивают фехтование на сосульках! Вообще-то, выглядит очень весело.
bulgarian: Then they swordfight with the icicles! Honestly, it looks kind of fun.

english: You know, it's actually the Dragonguard who keep snow and icicles off the request board.
french: Tu sais, c'est la Garde des dragons qui se charge d'enlever la neige et la glace du panneau des requêtes.
russian: А ты знаешь, что снег и сосульки с доски прошений счищает Драконья стража?
bulgarian: You know, it's actually the Dragonguard who keep snow and icicles off the request board.

english: There's nothing cozier than paperwork on a rainy day, [Ari].
french: Il n'y a rien de plus réconfortant que de faire de la paperasse un jour de pluie, [Ari].
russian: Нет ничего уютнее, чем позаполнять документацию в дождливый денёк, [Ari].
bulgarian: There's nothing cozier than paperwork on a rainy day, [Ari].

english: I shouldn't neglect my work, but hanging out with my friends is so fun. Maybe I can do both...
french: Je ne devrais pas négliger mon travail, mais je m'amuse tellement quand je sors avec mes amies. Je peux peut-être faire les deux...
russian: Нельзя, конечно, пренебрегать работой, но проводить время с друзьями так весело. Может, получится совместить...
bulgarian: I shouldn't neglect my work, but hanging out with my friends is so fun. Maybe I can do both...

english: Reina talked me into spending the evening with her and Celine.
french: Reina m'a proposé de passer la soirée avec elle et Céline.
russian: Рейна уговорила меня провести вечер с ней и Селин.
bulgarian: Reina talked me into spending the evening with her and Celine.

english: Reina says I should work less and play more... maybe she's right. Still... it seems like she's up at all hours at the Inn working on something too!
french: Reina dit que je devrais travailler moins et m'amuser plus. Elle a peut-être raison. Il n'empêche... Elle aussi est toujours debout, en train de s'activer à l'auberge !
russian: Рейна говорит, мне нужно меньше времени уделять работе и больше потехе... Может, она и права. Но она будто сама до утра занимается делами трактира!
bulgarian: Reina says I should work less and play more... maybe she's right. Still... it seems like she's up at all hours at the Inn working on something too!

english: Get excited, [Ari]! We're talking civil infrastructure!
french: Rends-toi compte, [Ari] ! On parle d'infrastructure civile !
russian: Порадуйся, [Ari]! Скоро мы займёмся остальной общественной инфраструктурой!
bulgarian: Get excited, [Ari]! We're talking civil infrastructure!

english: Repairing the bridge is only the beginning.
french: La réparation du pont n'est qu'un début.
russian: Ремонт моста — это только начало.
bulgarian: Repairing the bridge is only the beginning.

english: I'm always happy to see you checking the request board!
french: Je suis toujours ravie de te voir consulter le panneau des requêtes !
russian: Я так рада, что ты проверяешь доску прошений!
bulgarian: I'm always happy to see you checking the request board!

english: Again...
french: Ce n'est pas la première fois...
russian: Очередную...
bulgarian: Again...

english: Don't mind me, [Ari]... I'm just taking down Dell's request for "a really really big frog that also talks".
french: Ne t'occupe pas de moi, [Ari]... J'enlève simplement la requête de Dell pour « une très très grosse grenouille, qui parle, aussi ».
russian: Не обращай внимания, [Ari]... Я просто снимаю просьбу Делл найти «большущую лягушку, которая ещё и говорит».
bulgarian: Don't mind me, [Ari]... I'm just taking down Dell's request for "a really really big frog that also talks".

english: Isn't that sweet? She reminds me of myself at that age.
french: C'est mignon, non ? Elle me rappelle moi, à son âge.
russian: Разве это не чудесно? Она напоминает меня в её возрасте.
bulgarian: Isn't that sweet? She reminds me of myself at that age.

english: Well, in some ways...
french: Enfin, par certains côtés...
russian: Ну... В некоторых вещах.
bulgarian: Well, in some ways...

english: Dell said she wants to help fulfill requests from the request board when she grows up!
french: Dell dit qu'elle veut participer à la réalisation des demandes affichées au panneau des requêtes quand elle sera grande !
russian: Делл говорит, что хочет помогать выполнять прошения с доски, когда вырастет!
bulgarian: Dell said she wants to help fulfill requests from the request board when she grows up!

english: This request board has really done wonders for our town rank, don't you think?
french: Le panneau des requêtes a vraiment fait des merveilles pour le classement de notre ville, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Эта доска прошений сильно помогла нам с городским рангом, не так ли?
bulgarian: This request board has really done wonders for our town rank, don't you think?

english: Thanks so much for taking on all these requests! I know everyone really appreciates it!
french: Merci beaucoup de te charger de toutes ces demandes ! Je sais que tout le monde t'en est vraiment reconnaissant !
russian: Спасибо, что выполняешь все эти поручения! Я знаю, тебе все за это очень благодарны!
bulgarian: Thanks so much for taking on all these requests! I know everyone really appreciates it!

english: We put the request board up just before you came to Mistria, [Ari]! That means it's been over a year since you began helping out around town.
french: Nous avons installé le panneau des requêtes juste avant ton arrivée à Mistria, [Ari] ! Autrement dit, cela fait plus d'un an que tu apportes ton aide à la ville.
russian: Мы поставили доску прошений прямо перед твоим прибытием в Мистрию, [Ari]! Так что ты уже больше года помогаешь городу.
bulgarian: We put the request board up just before you came to Mistria, [Ari]! That means it's been over a year since you began helping out around town.

english: The town has come a long way since the earthquake, hasn't it? I'm so happy.
french: La ville revient de loin depuis le tremblement de terre, n'est-ce pas ? J'en suis tellement heureuse.
russian: Город сильно похорошел с тех пор, как мы начали восстанавливать его после землетрясения. Я так счастлива!
bulgarian: The town has come a long way since the earthquake, hasn't it? I'm so happy.

english: I can understand why he's so enthralled by the pursuit of archaeology.
french: Je comprends pourquoi il est si passionné par l'archéologie.
russian: Понимаю, почему археология так его впечатляет.
bulgarian: I can understand why he's so enthralled by the pursuit of archaeology.

english: Eiland asked for my help with some cataloging, but I keep stopping to appreciate the ruins.
french: Eiland m'a demandé de l'aide pour inventorier des objets, mais je n'arrête pas de m'interrompre pour admirer les ruines.
russian: Эйланд попросил меня помочь внести находки в каталог, но я постоянно отвлекаюсь на красоту руин.
bulgarian: Eiland asked for my help with some cataloging, but I keep stopping to appreciate the ruins.

english: He's a really capable person... in fact, you remind me of him, [Ari]!
french: C'est vraiment quelqu'un de compétent... D'ailleurs, tu me fais penser à lui, [Ari] !
russian: У него такие умелые руки... Ты мне его немного напоминаешь, [Ari]!
bulgarian: He's a really capable person... in fact, you remind me of him, [Ari]!

english: We've been lucky to have Ryis helping with repairs since the earthquake.
french: Ryis est pour beaucoup dans la reconstruction de Mistria. C'est vraiment quelqu'un de compétent... En réalité, tu me fais penser à lui, [Ari] !
russian: После землетрясения Риз стал помогать нам с ремонтом. Нам с ним очень повезло.
bulgarian: We've been lucky to have Ryis helping with repairs since the earthquake.

english: I spent sooo long in the sauna today... that was nice. I should do it more often...
french: J'ai passé un looong moment au sauna, aujourd'hui... C'était agréable. Je devrais le faire plus souvent...
russian: Я сегодня так долго провела в сауне... Как чудесно. Нужно делать это почаще...
bulgarian: I spent sooo long in the sauna today... that was nice. I should do it more often...

english: I've got to say, she's getting better and better at writing proposals. She's got a promising career ahead of her!
french: Je dois avouer qu'elle s'améliore sans cesse dans la rédaction de ses demandes. Elle a une carrière prometteuse devant elle !
russian: И, надо сказать, с каждым годом её заявки становятся лучше и лучше. У неё впереди многообещающая карьера!
bulgarian: I've got to say, she's getting better and better at writing proposals. She's got a promising career ahead of her!

english: Every year, the kids petition for snack funding for the Dragonguard. Maple's the one who spearheads it.
french: Chaque année, les enfants envoient une demande officielle de financement pour des encas destinés à la Garde des dragons. C'est Maple qui est à la manœuvre.
russian: Каждый год дети составляют петицию на финансирование Драконьей стражи вкуснями. Мэйпл её подаёт.
bulgarian: Every year, the kids petition for snack funding for the Dragonguard. Maple's the one who spearheads it.

english: I love doing the grocery shopping! It means I get to pick out the snacks.
french: J'adore aller faire des courses d'épicerie ! Comme ça, c'est moi qui choisis de quoi grignoter.
russian: Люблю закупаться продуктами! Если это делаю я, то и лакомства выбирать мне.
bulgarian: I love doing the grocery shopping! It means I get to pick out the snacks.

english: How horrible! I mean, is that even possible?
french: C'était horrible ! D'ailleurs, est-ce seulement possible ?
russian: Какой кошмар! Так не бывает.
bulgarian: How horrible! I mean, is that even possible?

english: I had the strangest dream last night! I ran out of paperwork.
french: J'ai fait un drôle de rêve la nuit dernière ! J'étais à court de documents à classer.
russian: Мне вчера приснился удивительный сон! У меня закончились документы на подписание.
bulgarian: I had the strangest dream last night! I ran out of paperwork.

english: But let me know if I can help with anything! I don't mind at all!
french: Mais dis-moi si je peux t'aider à quoi que ce soit ! Ça ne m'ennuie pas du tout !
russian: Но ты скажи, если нужно чем-то помочь! Я совсем не против!
bulgarian: But let me know if I can help with anything! I don't mind at all!

english: I promise I'm not working on a Sunday! I'm relaxing! Really, [Ari]!
french: Je te promets que je ne travaille pas le dimanche ! Je me détends ! Je t'assure, [Ari] !
russian: Я точно-точно говорю! Я не работаю в воскресенье! Я отдыхаю! Правда, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I promise I'm not working on a Sunday! I'm relaxing! Really, [Ari]!

english: Oh, I wish this filing would last forever!
french: Oh, j'aimerais que ce classement dure toujours !
russian: Ох, как бы мне хотелось, чтобы эта папка никогда не заканчивалась!
bulgarian: Oh, I wish this filing would last forever!

english: There's nothing better than doing paperwork outside, under the sun!
french: Il n'y a rien de mieux que de traiter des papiers à l'extérieur, au soleil !
russian: Заниматься бумагами на улице, под солнышком, всегда так приятно!
bulgarian: There's nothing better than doing paperwork outside, under the sun!

english: Thanks for always making time for me, [Ari]. I'm glad we can be more than work friends!
french: Merci de toujours dégager du temps pour moi, [Ari]. Je suis contente que nous puissions être plus que des relations de travail !
russian: Спасибо, что всегда уделяешь мне время, [Ari]. Я так рада, что мы больше, чем просто коллеги!
bulgarian: Thanks for always making time for me, [Ari]. I'm glad we can be more than work friends!

english: How time flies!
french: Le temps passe si vite !
russian: Как летит время!
bulgarian: How time flies!

english: It's been over a year since you moved to Mistria, [Ari]... Gosh, it feels like you've always been part of our community!
french: Cela fait plus d'un an que tu as emménagé à Mistria, [Ari]... C'est fou, j'ai l'impression que tu as toujours fait partie de notre communauté !
russian:
Ты в Мистрии уже больше года, [Ari]... Такое чувство, что ты с нами всегда

были

былабылбыло!
bulgarian: It's been over a year since you moved to Mistria, [Ari]... Gosh, it feels like you've always been part of our community!

english: The town's rank has really climbed since you first arrived! Thanks for all your hard work, [Ari].
french: La ville a vraiment grimpé au classement depuis ton arrivée ! Merci de travailler aussi dur, [Ari].
russian:
Городской ранг повысился выше всяких ожиданий, с тех пор как ты

прибыли

прибылаприбылприбыло! Спасибо за твою помощь, [Ari].
bulgarian: The town's rank has really climbed since you first arrived! Thanks for all your hard work, [Ari].

english: I like to maintain a rigorous archiving practice, so there's clear documentation for Mistrians of the future!
french: J'aime documenter les choses de façon rigoureuse, afin que les futurs habitants de Mistria disposent d'archives claires et précises !
russian: Люблю поддерживать тщательное ведение документации, чтобы у будущих мистрийцев были записи обо всём!
bulgarian: I like to maintain a rigorous archiving practice, so there's clear documentation for Mistrians of the future!

english: I suppose you could chalk that notion up to Eiland's struggle to understand the past.
french: J'imagine qu'on pourrait mettre cela sur le compte des difficultés que rencontre Eiland pour comprendre le passé.
russian: Возможно, это как-то связано с попытками Эйланда узнать больше о прошлом.
bulgarian: I suppose you could chalk that notion up to Eiland's struggle to understand the past.

english: I'm writing up a report for the town records.
french: Je suis en train de rédiger un rapport pour les archives de la ville.
russian: Я пишу отчёт для картотеки Мистрии.
bulgarian: I'm writing up a report for the town records.

english: Yeah... I don't want to brag, but this thing can take SO many notes.
french: Oui... Sans me vanter, j'arrive à mettre tellement d'infos, là-dessus.
russian: Не хочу хвастаться, но в него влезает ТАК много заметок!
bulgarian: Yeah... I don't want to brag, but this thing can take SO many notes.

english: Have you ever thought about using a clipboard to help plan your day?
french: Tu as déjà pensé à utiliser un bloc-notes pour t'aider dans l'organisation de ta journée ?
russian:
Ты не

пробовали

пробовалапробовалпробовало пользоваться планшетом для планирования дня?
bulgarian: Have you ever thought about using a clipboard to help plan your day?

english: Even though I grew up in Mistria, I always see something new when I'm out and about.
french: J'ai beau avoir grandi à Mistria, je découvre quelque chose de nouveau à chaque fois que je sors me promener.
russian: Я выросла в Мистрии и всё равно каждый раз нахожу что-то новое, когда гуляю.
bulgarian: Even though I grew up in Mistria, I always see something new when I'm out and about.

english: I'm exactly three minutes behind schedule, so I'm in a bit of a rush!
french: Je suis en retard d'exactement trois minutes sur mon planning, alors je suis un peu pressée !
russian: Я сейчас слегка спешу: отстала от графика ровно на три минуты!
bulgarian: I'm exactly three minutes behind schedule, so I'm in a bit of a rush!

english: Pardon me, [Ari]!
french: Excuse-moi, [Ari] !
russian: Прости, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Pardon me, [Ari]!

english: Where are you off to next?
french: Où vas-tu, ensuite ?
russian: Куда сейчас направляешься?
bulgarian: Where are you off to next?

english: You look so busy, [Ari]!
french: Tu sembles très <he>occupé</he><she>occupé</she><they>occupé·e</they>, [Ari] !
russian: У тебя такой занятой вид, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You look so busy, [Ari]!

english: Elsie talked me into taking some time off... warming up at the Bathhouse does sound nice.
french: Elsie m'a conseillé de prendre un peu de repos... L'idée d'aller me relaxer aux bains est assez tentante.
russian: Элси уговорила меня взять небольшой отдых... Погреться в ванной, действительно, звучит приятно.
bulgarian: Elsie talked me into taking some time off... warming up at the Bathhouse does sound nice.

english: Whew... Elsie's got so many stories, and they're all over the top. But Reina does love to hear them secondhand...
french: Pfiou... Elsie a tellement d'histoires à raconter, toutes incroyables. Mais Reina adore quand je les lui raconte...
russian: Ух... У Элси столько историй, и все они такие впечатляющие. Рейне очень нравится их слушать...
bulgarian: Whew... Elsie's got so many stories, and they're all over the top. But Reina does love to hear them secondhand...

english: I've got a mountain of paperwork to get back to... oh I'm not complaining! I can't wait!
french: J'ai une montagne de papiers qui m'attend... Oh, je ne suis pas en train de me plaindre ! J'ai hâte !
russian: Меня ждет целая гора бумаг... о, нет, я не жалуюсь. Наоборот, не могу дождаться!
bulgarian: I've got a mountain of paperwork to get back to... oh I'm not complaining! I can't wait!

english: I was thinking of working at the Inn today... sometimes it's nice to be around people, even if you don't have time to chat.
french: Je me suis dit que j'allais travailler à l'auberge, aujourd'hui. C'est parfois agréable d'être entourée de gens, même si on n'a pas le temps de discuter.
russian: Я подумываю поработать сегодня в трактире... Иногда здорово побыть среди людей, даже если времени поговорить нет.
bulgarian: I was thinking of working at the Inn today... sometimes it's nice to be around people, even if you don't have time to chat.

english: I bet a little treat is just what I need to power through.
french: Une petite douceur est pile ce dont j'ai besoin pour me donner l'énergie d'avancer.
russian: Думаю, небольшой перекус — то, что нужно, чтобы справиться со всем.
bulgarian: I bet a little treat is just what I need to power through.

english: I'm trying to iron out some wrinkles in the budget...
french: J'essaie d'aplanir quelques imprévus dans le budget...
russian: Я пытаюсь залатать некоторые дыры в бюджете...
bulgarian: I'm trying to iron out some wrinkles in the budget...

english: Sorry, I was just thinking about some forms I need to fill out later.
french: Tout le monde est tellement enthousiaste de voir une nouvelle personne en ville !
russian: Прости, я задумалась. Размышляла, как буду заполнять формы.
bulgarian: Sorry, I was just thinking about some forms I need to fill out later.

english: Oh! Hi [Ari].
french: La fierté de Mistria est d'être une ville accueillante, alors ne sois pas timide et passe saluer tes voisins.
russian: Ой! Привет, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh! Hi [Ari].

Ты не

думали

думаладумалдумало покрасить волосы, [Ari]?

принесли

принеслапринёспринесло в музей $муравьиную матку$... У неё трудная работа! За это я её уважаю.
